summary: The literal generator-or-remover reading yields a mover per se or per accidens, not a per-se mover for every physical motion. The finite literalReadingDoesNotGivePerSeMover control permits a light thing moved only by the remover of a hindrance. The stronger per-se result retains an explicit open premise; broad reduction-to-act scope also requires a separate open bridge. See docs/typed-physics.md, Findings 1–2. Follow-up bounded motion/mover investigation (2026-11-08): preview experiments separate a distinct mover from some mover and physical coverage from broad reduction; the nonphysical residual requires an explicit open branch. These are development diagnostics, not registered verified results. Findings, rejected identifications, exact proof content and remaining typed-fork blockers are preserved in docs/notes/motion-mover-fork.md.
